INTEL_INDICATOR_TYPE.description: Mandatory Falcon indicator type to fetch — one of 'hash_md5', 'hash_sha256', 'ip_address', 'domain', 'url'. Forwarded to Falcon Intel as filter=type:'{type}' so the API itself does the type-narrowing; anything else is rejected client-side with a hard error so a typo doesn't silently pull every indicator type. Case is normalised (the value is lower-cased before the filter is built). Falcon's published indicator vocabulary is larger (hash_sha1, ip_address_block, mutex_name, file_name, ...) but this executor's contract is narrowed to the five most-requested types per the playbook spec — operators who need the others should run a separate scan with the appropriate type.

INTEL_MAX_RESULTS.description: Optional upper bound on the total number of indicator records to accumulate (default 500). The executor pages /intel/combined/indicators/v1 in 500-record pages via offset/limit until either INTEL_MAX_RESULTS is reached, the Falcon result set is exhausted (offset >= meta.pagination.total), or the result set goes empty. Sort is last_updated.desc so the newest indicators are at the head of the result set — the typical 'give me the last N indicators of type X' operational mode. Values <= 0 are clamped to the default (the operator most likely fat-fingered a sign / forgot a digit); values above 10000 are clamped to 10000 to keep the dispatcher responsive on chatty tenants. Blank / missing / unparseable input falls back to the default.

name: crowdstrike_intel
title: CrowdStrike Falcon Intel Indicators
description: CrowdStrike Falcon Intel indicator-of-compromise (IOC) importer. Pulls IOC records from the Falcon Intel REST API (https://api.crowdstrike.com/intel/combined/indicators/v1 with /intel/queries/indicators/v1 documented as the alternative two-call ids+entities pattern) and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON. Falcon Intel is the analyst / threat-intelligence side of CrowdStrike's platform (separate from the host-side Spotlight / Detects feeds the sibling 'crowdstrike' executor consumes from JSON exports) — it publishes hashes, IPs, domains, and URLs CrowdStrike analysts have associated with named threat actors / malware families. Auth: standard Falcon OAuth2 client_credentials grant at POST /oauth2/token with form body client_id=...&client_secret=...; the returned bearer token is sent as Authorization: Bearer ... on every subsequent call. Reuses the canonical Falcon env vars: FALCON_CLIENT_ID + FALCON_CLIENT_SECRET (mandatory) and FALCON_HOST (optional — defaults to https://api.crowdstrike.com, the US-1 default; can be overridden to point at a regional host like api.us-2.crowdstrike.com / api.eu-1.crowdstrike.com / api.laggar.gcw.crowdstrike.com). Args: INTEL_INDICATOR_TYPE (mandatory — one of hash_md5 / hash_sha256 / ip_address / domain / url) is forwarded as filter=type:'{type}'; INTEL_MAX_RESULTS (optional integer, default 500) caps the total records accumulated. Each indicator becomes one Faraday vulnerability under a single synthetic 0.0.0.0 host with hostname 'crowdstrike-intel' (Falcon Intel indicators are IOC-keyed not host-keyed — the operator's other agents emit the host-side findings this feed is correlated against), tagged exactly ['crowdstrike-intel'] with a [CS-Intel] name prefix, the canonical indicator value + type in the name, and the Falcon record id in external_id. Severity is bucketed from Falcon's malicious_confidence (high -> high; medium -> medium; low -> low; unverified -> info; missing -> info), then BUMPED one tier when the record names any threat actor (Falcon only attaches actor labels with high analyst confidence so the bump is well-justified) and BUMPED again when the kill_chains list includes 'actionOnObjectives' (post-exploitation IOCs). Bumps compound. Refs include the indicator value, type, malicious_confidence, named actors, malware families, kill chains, threat types, targets, Falcon Intel report ids, label names, linked CVE ids (each with its canonical NVD permalink), the Falcon record id, and the published_date / last_updated timestamps so operators can pivot from a Faraday finding back to the Falcon Intel record. Status is always open (a Falcon Intel indicator cannot be 'fixed' in the catalog — it can only be blocked on the operator's perimeter / EDR). Resolution defaults to a type-appropriate blocking recommendation (domains -> sinkhole + perimeter blocklist; IPs -> firewall + egress proxy + EDR containment; URLs -> egress proxy + endpoint web-filter; hashes -> EDR / AV / Falcon prevention policy). Tags: [crowdstrike-intel].
